scope: Offline source binding for explicitly admitted Linux x86_64 LP64 glibc sigaction layout; no native query or compiler.
derivation: Linux sigaction.h orders handler union, __sigset_t mask, int flags, restorer function pointer. The Linux-specific __sigset_t.h declares 1024/(8*sizeof(unsigned long)) words. x86 wordsize.h selects 64 only for x86_64 without ILP32. LP64 layout with 8-byte pointer/long alignment and 4-byte int yields offsets 0/8/136/144 and total 152. The hosted inspector must validate its ctypes geometry before the readonly call.
runtimePreconditions: Actual ctypes pointer/long/int sizes and field offsets match
